title: CSAR Rescues for {name}
description:
Rank: **{rank}**
Total Rescued Pilots: **{total}** across **{events}** missions

params.sql: SELECT helicopterused as "Rescue Helicopter", SUM(savedpilots) as "Pilots Rescued" FROM csar_events WHERE ucid = %(ucid)s GROUP BY helicopterused ORDER BY SUM(savedpilots) DESC
